_about: The original 'The opened parcel' case (city_missions.gd legacy_steps) migrated to data: same id, title, reward, four stages, contacts, clue, placement, lines and offer. Added only what the engine verbs need: the parcel may be photographed instead of inspected, the witness is a recorded interview, and the officer files the report only with that evidence. Any officer may take a report.
title: The opened parcel
summary: A resident's delivery is missing. Record the opened carton, hear the Dumbarton witness, and report only what is known.

scene_record.label: Delivery label on the empty carton

objectives.objective: Ask the resident about an opened delivery
objectives.dialogue: My delivery is missing. There may be some packing material farther up Old York. Please check before reporting anything.

stages.objective: Inspect the opened parcel on Old York Road (a phone photo also counts)

objectives.objective: Inspect the opened parcel on Old York Road
objectives.dialogue: The empty carton has the resident's delivery label. Record the location; leave the evidence here.

objectives.objective: Or photograph the opened parcel from the sidewalk
objectives.notice: Photo recorded: the opened carton and its delivery label are in frame. Leave the evidence where it is.

objectives.objective: Ask the witness at Dumbarton what happened
objectives.greeting: You're asking about that doorstep on Old York?

topics.ask: What did you see at that doorstep?
topics.answer: I saw someone remove a parcel from that doorstep. I couldn't identify them. Tell the officer exactly that.

objectives.objective: Report the evidence to the officer near Wyanoke
objectives.greeting: What did you find about that delivery?
objectives.missing: Bring me what you recorded at the doorstep and what the witness saw, then I can file it.
objectives.dialogue: I'll record the missing delivery and the witness account. We will investigate; a report is not proof of who took it.
